mapper.select: SELECT auth.id as id, auth.auth_id AS authId, auth.parent_auth_id pAuthId, auth.auth_name AS authName, auth.auth_description AS description, auth.is_checked AS isCheck from auth_info auth, role_auth_relation rar, user_role_info usi, user_info ui where auth.auth_id = rar.auth_id AND usi.role_id = rar.role_id AND ui.user_id = usi.user_id AND ui.user_name = #{userName}

SELECT distinct(auth.id), auth.auth_id, auth.parent_auth_id, auth.auth_name, auth.auth_description, auth.is_checked from auth_info auth, role_auth_relation rar, user_role_info usi where auth.auth_id = rar.auth_id AND usi.role_id = rar.role_id AND usi.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT auth.auth_id AS authId, auth.parent_auth_id AS pAuthId, auth.auth_name AS authName, auth.auth_description AS description, auth.is_checked AS isCheck FROM auth_info auth

SELECT auth_id AS authId, parent_auth_id AS pAuthId, auth_name AS authName, auth_description AS description, case when temp.roleId = #{roleId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isCheck FROM auth_info LEFT JOIN (SELECT auth.auth_id AS authId, rar.role_id AS roleId FROM auth_info auth left join role_auth_relation rar on auth.auth_id = rar.auth_id where rar.role_id = #{roleId} ) AS temp on temp.authId = auth_info.auth_id
